rules.entry: each fixed asset at first01:00UTCopen; long spot, equal-net-base short perpetual; no funding forecasts or timing
rules.holding: fixed base quantity without rebalancing until last23:00UTCopen before phase end, unless known-hour margin-equity/notional<=20percent or portfolio marked drawdown>=5percent triggers next-hour whole-book exit
rules.funding: actual events with original millisecond clock; entry<event<=exit; mark at containing-hour open is explicitly a settlement proxy
rules.fee_inventory: spot entry fee charged in base with gross=q/(1-fee), spot exit fee in quote; exact same net q short perp; continuous quantities at initial economic screen
rules.capital: each asset25percent spot,70percent isolated short collateral,5percent reserve; no borrowing or external deposits
rules.sampling: full hourly NAV; all complete calendar month returns including marked inventory; one continuous account per scenario
rules.quantity: q=0.25*asset_capital*(1-spot_fee)/(prior completed-hour spot close*(1+registered slippage)); entry market quote gap must still fit allocated asset capital and fixed70percent collateral, otherwise cash for whole account
rules.monthly_returns: last observed hourly NAV in each complete UTC calendar month divided by previous month last NAV; first denominator is initial capital; these are sampled hourly monthly observations

gates_scope: A distinct continuous economic baseline, not H04 prediction-window retuning; closed-trade minimum30 from directional experiments is not relabelled as passed. Funding events and months are dependence-aware diagnostic coverage, not independent trade samples. Native lot/partial-fill and historical maintenance-tier proof remain mandatory before any live eligibility.

source_context.prior_rejected_study: TradingAgents H04 24-hour funding regression; unchanged result retained
source_context.difference: unconditional long-horizon two-asset continuous cash account with explicit collateral, no forecast or funding-timing selection

revision_reason: Clarify causal entry quantity from prior completed-hour spot close, rather than using the eventual fill to size. No economic result computed before this revision.
scope_limitations: Continuous quantities and assumed fills are only an initial economic screen; no lot or partial-fill proof
Funding uses original event milliseconds but containing-hour mark open as a price proxy
Current source calendars and membership are retrospective, not independent OOS
Current execution volume participation is a source-volume proxy, not orderbook capacity proof
